Container.Name: Norri
Container.Overview: Norri is a self-hosted media server for your movies, TV shows and music, with a web interface and native apps for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.[br][br]The open beta is free to try. This Unraid Docker template installs the server, database and transcoder together, with optional hardware transcoding.[br][br]Join our Discord for support, discussion and announcements. Installation guides and Apple app links are also available at norri.tv.[br][br]Unraid® is a registered trademark of Lime Technology, Inc. This application is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Lime Technology, Inc.

Config.Name: Web interface
Config.Description: Open Norri using this port. Change the host port if another container already uses 11423.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Select your existing Unraid movies folder. It appears at /media/movies in Norri. Leave blank if unused; no deletion needed.

Config.Name: TV shows
Config.Description: Select your existing Unraid TV folder. It appears at /media/tv-shows in Norri. Leave blank if unused; no deletion needed.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Select your existing Unraid music folder. It appears at /media/music in Norri. Leave blank if unused; no deletion needed.

Config.Name: Norri appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Norri settings, artwork and cache. Keep this folder when updating or reinstalling.

Config.Name: Norri database
Config.Description: Persistent database. Keep this folder when updating or reinstalling. It must be separate from Norri appdata and your media.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid's standard nobody user. Change only if your media uses a different user ID.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Unraid's standard users group. Change only if your media uses a different group ID.
